context: A business is reviewing its marketing decisions.
stem: Select the option that best defines an integrated marketing mix.

options.label: A
options.text: Using promotion as the sole method of increasing sales.

options.label: B
options.text: Coordinating marketing decisions so that they consistently support the target customer and positioning.

options.label: C
options.text: Setting the lowest possible price in every market.

options.label: D
options.text: Classifying each product according to market growth and relative market share.

option_rationale: A is incorrect because promotion is only one element of marketing and does not alone create an integrated mix.
B is correct because an integrated marketing mix aligns decisions such as product, price, promotion, channels and, where relevant, service elements.
C is incorrect because low pricing may conflict with a business's positioning, costs or customer-value proposition.
D is incorrect because this describes the purpose of the BCG growth-share matrix, a portfolio framework rather than an integrated marketing mix.
